svg.title: PayLink - Refund a completed payment (FR-27, payment stays COMPLETED)

g.text: PayLink - Refund a completed payment (FR-27, payment stays COMPLETED)
1. The customer asks for a refund (US-27.1, US-27.4)
[the payment is not COMPLETED, or it is not the customer's payment]
FAILED payments are refunded by the normal flow
[the payment already has an APPROVED RefundRequest]
refused (a payment is paid back only once)
Reads the LedgerEntries of the payment
(DEBIT, FEE_INCOME and, if an agent was involved, COMMISSION)
and posts one REVERSAL entry for each. Nothing is edited or deleted.
(returns the fee income and pays the amount the biller already kept)
(only what the agent still has available)
If the agent already spent part of it, PayLink absorbs
the difference (D-14). The agent wallet never goes negative.
COMPLETED is final and REFUNDED comes only from FAILED,
so the payment status does not change.
